pages.text: --- Page 1 --- V-SENGATTAIAN KA·SROKATTAIANI N'SAOATTAIAN! TANGPILATTAANI D.D. --- Page 3 --- AN·SENGATTAIANI KA·SROKATTAIANI AN·SAOATTAIANI TANGPILATTAIANI F.
Harding, D.D. No.28 - 1000 - 10-8-42 --- Page 5 --- ihis bouk blonas to Goer AN-SENGATTAIANI, KA·SROKATTAIANI AN-SAOATTAIANI, TANGPILATTAIANI. Bilsi chikungna skang Turao Dr.
Phillips sagini bungalow kamatako manaha. Uni somoio lechu bol pangsako kamchapaha. Cheksirang baksa bitongba wa'alchi nisiatako man'aha.

Ua bol mamung saloba ritimjawa, biteko pangnaba nangtaijawa gita nikachim. Uni chongipa bolchongdikko supee galsrangenba, ua biapo a-ako bake apsanatode nitobatnikgenchim ine chanchiaha. Indiba memsahib chanchiaha, ua bol sisranga gita nikoba, chataiani cholko una on'ode nama.

Uni gimin uko supegija tangpiltaiani cholko on-skaaha. Ru-utgijan ua bolchongdikoni cheksirang chabataie, bijak ritimtaie, manchoktaie bibal baltaie, bon-kamao bite nangtaie jamano uko ake ua sigiminoni lechu biteko chinga cha'taiaha. Uandake ua salintal bilsiantio cha-taitaiaha.
Ian toani. Maiba mondoliko ua lechu bol sigipa baksa tosusana ama. Sisrangaha gita ua mondoli ong'a.
Ua bol gita a-ako gimaaba gimaatarienga, uko supegenode nambatsusu nika. Indiba Isol an-ching gita nikja aro chanchija. Ua mondolio Ua saniba saniba ka'tongrango toromko ching'taiatna walkiko nika.

Ua Isolni Songnokna ka'pakgipa chongipa dolo Isol kadongenba ua mondoliko spoe toromni wa-alko ching-attaina ama. la A.chik songni [1] --- Page 6 --- mondolirangni itihasko name sandiode basikba chang indake ong-baaha. Anga gisik ra'enga maikai angni ia Achik songona re-bachenganio maiba jolo mofossil wenmitingo, saksa bebegipa Kristian budepani noko romitingo, ua angko sepanggipa a-dingni kosakona re-dilaha.

Unoni niwate ua jol gimikko nikna man'a. Unikoa ua budepa ua biap damsani ja'mano biap damgipinrangko jaksi ote angna mesokate aganaha, skango ua biaprango Jisu Kristoni askirang teng suengachim indiba dao ua jolo donggipa kristianrang Isoloni an'pile ua chakkirang siangtokaha. Dao ua jolrangni andalaniara bebera na skang andalanina bate batenga ine ua grape agandapaha.

Ua jolrangni andalaniara uni ka'tongo bal jrimbcgipa ong-achim -- indita jrimgipa salprakprako Isolo mol-molchakaha maikai ua andalsimsimo Isolni chakkirang ching:piltaie teng: sutaigen. Ru'utmano ua jolo Isolni chakkirang ching'taie teng'sutataiaha. Gilja ka'taina a:bachengaha, skulrangko dontaiaha.
Beben sigimin tangpiltaiaha. Anga uko nikaha, aro Isolko mitelaha. Pil-e, Achik songo gittim damsa donga jeo saksa budepamung uni jikgipa uamang sakgnina agre pilakan Isolko watgalaha.

Ua song changsa mondolini ma-mong ong'aha, indiba chu ringe, aping cha'e, namgijako dakroroange ua song seng'aoni an'pile andalachipak [2] --- Page 7 --- mikkangchake tangangaha. Ia budepa chonbegipa gilja nokko rikaha. Robibaro ua kontako pangnan dokrongaha, indiba ua aro an'tangni jikgipana agre pilakba Isolko olakkina tom-bajachim.

Re-bajaoba uamang sakgni nom'angjachim.Uamang sakgni banga bilsirangni gisepo indake robibarprakprako konta doke gilja noko tom'e Isolo bi-chakaha. Uamang Jisuni indine ku'rachake aganani chu'sokaniko uimangiparang ongachim - - "Jeo sakgni sakgittam angni bimungo tom:a, uon Anga uamangni gisepo gnang"(Mati 18:20). Uamang sakgniko Isol salgichi rimangaha, indioba uamang sina skang pilakba uamang baksa Isolko olakkina giljachi re-barongjachim.

Uamang simanosa uamangni krengani, bimchipani, Isolko pangnan rasong chaatani, Isolo pangnan mol-molchakani bite nanganiko an-chinga nikaha. Ua songogiparang gisik pil-aha, uamang giljachi re-taiaha, uamang namgijaoni Isolona an:pilaha.

Sigimin tangpiltaiaha. Anga antangan uko nikaha, aro Isolko mitelaha. Sigimin mondoliko tangatpilna Isol tapprao donnugimin tangengpitigipa bebera'gipa wal-kiko Gisik Rongtalgipachi spoate tangpilata.
Isolni dongspara Uni sakki on'gipa onga. Mondoliko an'saoataniara Isolni toromna okkrichongmot-giparangoni a-bachengna nanga. Bichal Isolninrangoni a bachengna nangchenga.

Isol Uni mondoliko rongtalat-chengon Ua indakgipa chongipa dolko an'saoatchenga. Ia chongipa jakko ia Isolni [s] --- Page 8 --- dongspako, maikai Isol name jakkalna mangen uamang skang Isolni Gisikni rongtalataniko nangchenga; uamangni janggi tanganirangoni silki galatako man'na nanga, maikai uamang rongchingbegipa janerarang gita teng'sugiparang ong·bagen. Satanko chena ia dakgrikanio Isolna ka'sachongmotgiparang Isolo bi-anichi, paptangtangko ku-rachakanichi, an-tangtangko Isolna on-kanganichi chegen.

Ru-utana skang Asia Minorni Sardis songjinmao donggipa Kristian mondolini gimin Parapeao Johon indine seaha : ‘'Nang'ni kamrangko, chong'motan na-a tangani bimungko man'aha, indiba na'a sia ine anga uia. Na'a mikrakbo, aro sinasigipa dongengsparangko mangrakatbo; maina anga nangni mamung kamrangkoba angni Isolni mikkango chu-sokatako man;jaha. Uni gimin na-a maikai man-aha aro knaaha uko gisik ra-bo; aro uko rakibo aro gisik pil-bo" (Parap.

Uni abachengao Sardis mondoli namgipa bimchipgipa ong'achim, indiba ja'mano ua sigipa, bimung mangmangkosan man:gipa ong:baskaaha. Sardis songjinma dal-gipa ong-achim. Uni ning'o Jisu Kristo ua mondoliko chakki gita donaha, indiba ua chakki siangenggipa ong-bae teng'sujachim, uni seng'ara andalasa ong-baskaaha.

Jekai ru-utana skang Sardisogipa mondoli ong'baaha uandake da'ororoba gipin a'songrangogipa maiba mondolirang ong-baaha. Uamangni Isolni gimin sakki gri, [4] --- Page 9 --- uamang siangenggipa chakkini chadoenggipa wal-ku gita ong'aia. Uamango donggipa seng'a andala ong baskaaha.

Oe, indakgipa mondoli ge-sa ba ge'gni A-chik songo donga. Uamangni bimung donga indiba uamang tusienga ba siangenga. Uni memborrangni gisepo bang-bean Isolni suakpile ona tomtoma aro katchapilaniko katongtangtango uijaenga.

Indakgipa mondolio maiba donnugimin wal-ki dongengnaba donga jeko spoe tangatkuna man'naba donga. “"Sinasigipa dongengsparangko mangrakatbo" ine mikrakata, maina ia dongengsparango je mondolikoba an'saopilataniara pangchaka. Ua dongspa dongode, ua mondolini gimin ka-dongani dongengpiti.

Isol "begopgipa tuluko pejawa, aro tochrini kilding dimikako ua kimitjawa" (Mati 12:20). Nangni uigimin mondolirangni gisepo, na'a indakgipako pangnaba nikkujachimma ? Nikbebemanaha ine aganchakna man:genkon.

Ua mondolini tapprarango toromni wal-ki dongengkuode, ua mondoliko namatpilani aro an'saoatpilani chol donga ine ka-dongani gnang. Maikai indita ka-dongani chu-sokatako mangen, Isolni suake on'a katchapilaniko, ning'tugipa tom-tomaniko, chakna ampilgijagipa nambea pattianiko man:aniona re-angpiltaina ramako ka'mao jaksi ote mesokenga. [5] --- Page 10 --- (1) Mondolitangko an'sengpilataniara Kristonirango a-bachenggen.

Uamangko rongtalatchenganio pangchaka. Uamangni dal-begipa dai nangani gnang. Mondoliko namatpilanio ong'chenggipa nanggniara Isolo ka-donggijanirangko an'saoatani, uamangko Isol baksa nangrimatsrangani ong'a.

Uamang rongtalatako man-manosa Isol uamangko mondoli gimikko an-sengatpilna jakkalgen. Ua mondolio uamangara Isolni gangbuatgnigipa wanti ong-a. Uamangara chonbegipa tangenggipa wal-misisan jechi Isol dal:gipa wa-alko ching-attaigen, mondoliko tangatpilgipaan.

Isolni nok chong'motko itrokchengna nanga, Uni ganchio dangdike on'giparangni jakrangko susrangchengna nanga, indakgiparang skang rongtalataniko manchengna nanga, uamang skang an'tangtangni pilak namgija dakanirangko chel-atchengna nanga. Mondoliko dakdilgiparang an-tangtangan skang pilak namgijako dondikchengchina. Indake ong-baon, Isol mondoli gimikni kosako suakpile tona ampilgijagipa pattianirangko rudapna man'gen.

Unon mondoli an'saopilataniko man-e katchabee ka-sroke Isolni tom'tomako uigen. Maikai indake ongna man'gen, jerangan mondolitangko namatpilna sikbea, uamang sakprakprakan do'gako chipchange dongnuao, Isolni mikkango donge, Isol Pagipani Gisik uamangni ka'tongtangtangko sandie [6]
